purpose.statement: TAXCALC is a batch COBOL program that reads an employee master file and computes progressive annual income tax for each employee across four tax brackets (0%, 10%, 20%, 30%), then writes a formatted tax report showing gross pay, tax withheld, net pay, and effective tax rate per employee, along with a grand-total trailer.

code_references.snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. TAXCALC.

MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT EMP-FILE OUTPUT RPT-FILE
           MOVE "ANNUAL INCOME TAX REPORT" TO RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE
           ...
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ EMP-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM CALC-TAX
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           ...
           STOP RUN.

CALC-TAX.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 30000
               ...
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-NET = EMP-SALARY - WS-TAX
           ...

business_rules.statement: Employees with annual gross salary of $0 through $30,000 (inclusive) are taxed at 0% — tax withheld is $0.

code_references.snippet:
EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 30000
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-TAX

business_rules.statement: Employees with annual gross salary of $30,001 through $60,000 (inclusive) are taxed at 10% on the amount exceeding $30,000. Formula: TAX = (EMP-SALARY - 30,000) × 0.10.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 60000
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED =
                       (EMP-SALARY - 30000) * 0.10

business_rules.statement: Employees with annual gross salary of $60,001 through $90,000 (inclusive) are taxed at 20% on the amount exceeding $60,000, plus the $3,000 tax already accumulated in the lower bracket. Formula: TAX = 3,000 + (EMP-SALARY - 60,000) × 0.20.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 90000
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED =
                       3000 + (EMP-SALARY - 60000) * 0.20

business_rules.statement: Employees with annual gross salary above $90,000 are taxed at 30% on the amount exceeding $90,000, plus the $9,000 tax already accumulated in the lower brackets. Formula: TAX = 9,000 + (EMP-SALARY - 90,000) × 0.30.

code_references.snippet:
WHEN OTHER
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED =
                       9000 + (EMP-SALARY - 90000) * 0.30

business_rules.statement: Net pay for each employee is calculated as: NET PAY = EMP-SALARY − WS-TAX.

code_references.snippet: COMPUTE WS-NET = EMP-SALARY - WS-TAX

business_rules.statement: The effective tax rate percentage is calculated for each employee as: RATE = (WS-TAX × 100) / EMP-SALARY, rounded to one decimal place.

code_references.snippet: COMPUTE WS-RATE ROUNDED = WS-TAX * 100 / EMP-SALARY

business_rules.statement: A running cumulative total of all tax withheld is maintained across all employees and printed on the report trailer line.

code_references.snippet: ADD WS-TAX TO WS-TOTAL-TAX

WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-TAX TO TRL-TAX
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM TRL-LINE

business_rules.statement: All intermediate tax and rate computations use ROUNDED arithmetic to avoid truncation errors.

code_references.snippet:
COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED =
                       (EMP-SALARY - 30000) * 0.10
               ...
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED =
                       3000 + (EMP-SALARY - 60000) * 0.20
               ...
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED =
                       9000 + (EMP-SALARY - 90000) * 0.30
COMPUTE WS-RATE ROUNDED = WS-TAX * 100 / EMP-SALARY

business_rules.statement: File reading continues until the AT END condition is raised on EMP-FILE, at which point the END-OF-FILE flag (WS-EOF) is set to 'Y' and the read loop terminates.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ EMP-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM CALC-TAX
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM

inputs.statement: EMP-FILE: Sequential flat file at 'data/input/employees.dat' containing employee records. Record layout is defined by the EMPREC copybook (fields include EMP-ID, EMP-NAME, EMP-SALARY).

code_references.snippet:
SELECT EMP-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/input/employees.dat"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

FD  EMP-FILE.
           COPY EMPREC.

outputs.statement: RPT-FILE: Sequential report file written to 'data/output/tax.rpt'. Contains a report title, column header, separator lines, one detail line per employee (ID, name, gross pay, tax, net pay, effective rate), a separator line, and a grand-total trailer line showing total tax withheld.

code_references.snippet:
SELECT RPT-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/output/tax.rpt"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

FD  RPT-FILE.
       01  RPT-LINE                PIC X(80).

OPEN INPUT EMP-FILE OUTPUT RPT-FILE
           MOVE "ANNUAL INCOME TAX REPORT" TO RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM HDR-1
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           ...
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-TAX TO TRL-TAX
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM TRL-LINE
           CLOSE EMP-FILE RPT-FILE

processing_logic.statement: STEP 1 — INITIALIZATION: Open EMP-FILE for input and RPT-FILE for output.

code_references.snippet: OPEN INPUT EMP-FILE OUTPUT RPT-FILE

processing_logic.statement: STEP 2 — WRITE REPORT HEADER: Write the report title ('ANNUAL INCOME TAX REPORT'), a separator line, the column header line (HDR-1), and another separator line to RPT-FILE.

code_references.snippet:
MOVE "ANNUAL INCOME TAX REPORT" TO RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM HDR-1
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE

processing_logic.statement: STEP 3 — READ LOOP: Repeatedly read records from EMP-FILE. On successful read, invoke CALC-TAX to compute and write the detail line. Loop exits when AT END is raised.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ EMP-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM CALC-TAX
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM

processing_logic.statement: STEP 4 — TAX CALCULATION (CALC-TAX): For each employee record, determine the tax bracket via EVALUATE, compute WS-TAX, WS-NET, and WS-RATE, accumulate WS-TOTAL-TAX, populate the DTL-LINE output fields, and write the detail line to RPT-FILE.

code_references.snippet:
CALC-TAX.
           EVALUATE TRUE
               WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 30000
                   MOVE 0 TO WS-TAX
               WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 60000
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED = (EMP-SALARY - 30000) * 0.10
               WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 90000
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED = 3000 + (EMP-SALARY - 60000) * 0.20
               WHEN OTHER
                   COMPUTE WS-TAX ROUNDED = 9000 + (EMP-SALARY - 90000) * 0.30
           END-EVALUATE
           COMPUTE WS-NET = EMP-SALARY - WS-TAX
           COMPUTE WS-RATE ROUNDED = WS-TAX * 100 / EMP-SALARY
           ADD WS-TAX TO WS-TOTAL-TAX
           MOVE EMP-ID     TO DTL-ID
           ...
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM DTL-LINE.

processing_logic.statement: STEP 5 — WRITE REPORT TRAILER: After the read loop, write a separator line, move the accumulated WS-TOTAL-TAX to TRL-TAX, and write the trailer line showing 'TOTAL TAX WITHHELD' and the grand total.

code_references.snippet:
WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-TAX TO TRL-TAX
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM TRL-LINE
           CLOSE EMP-FILE RPT-FILE

processing_logic.statement: STEP 6 — TERMINATION: Close both files, display a completion message to the system console, and stop the run.

code_references.snippet:
CLOSE EMP-FILE RPT-FILE
           DISPLAY "TAXCALC: TAX REPORT WRITTEN"
           STOP RUN.

dependencies.statement: EMPREC copybook: Defines the physical record layout for EMP-FILE, providing at minimum the fields EMP-ID, EMP-NAME, and EMP-SALARY referenced throughout CALC-TAX and the detail-line population logic.

code_references.snippet:
FD  EMP-FILE.
           COPY EMPREC.

WHEN EMP-SALARY <= 30000
               ...
           MOVE EMP-ID     TO DTL-ID
           MOVE EMP-NAME   TO DTL-NAME
           MOVE EMP-SALARY TO DTL-GROSS

dependencies.statement: Input flat file 'data/input/employees.dat': Physical sequential data file that must exist and be accessible at runtime for the program to read employee records.

code_references.snippet:
SELECT EMP-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/input/employees.dat"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

dependencies.statement: Output directory 'data/output/': The target directory for 'tax.rpt' must exist and be writable at runtime for the program to create or overwrite the report file.

code_references.snippet:
SELECT RPT-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/output/tax.rpt"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

error_handling.statement: AT END handling: The only explicit file-error handling is the AT END clause on the READ statement, which sets WS-EOF to 'Y' (via the END-OF-FILE condition-name) to gracefully terminate the read loop. No FILE STATUS codes, invalid key handling, or abend trapping are coded.

code_references.snippet:
PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ EMP-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM CALC-TAX
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM

01  WS-EOF                  PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88  END-OF-FILE         VALUE 'Y'.

error_handling.statement: Completion acknowledgement: A DISPLAY statement writes 'TAXCALC: TAX REPORT WRITTEN' to the system console upon normal completion, providing a runtime audit trail. No error-specific message or non-zero return code is issued for abnormal conditions.

code_references.snippet: DISPLAY "TAXCALC: TAX REPORT WRITTEN"

error_handling.statement: No divide-by-zero guard: The effective rate computation divides by EMP-SALARY. If EMP-SALARY is zero, a division-by-zero runtime error will occur. No protective check is coded.

code_references.snippet: COMPUTE WS-RATE ROUNDED = WS-TAX * 100 / EMP-SALARY

downstream_effects.statement: Tax report file 'data/output/tax.rpt': The primary downstream artifact. This human-readable report can be consumed by payroll administrators, auditors, or downstream report-distribution processes to verify tax withholdings per employee and confirm the organization's total annual tax liability.

code_references.snippet:
SELECT RPT-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/output/tax.rpt"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.

MOVE "ANNUAL INCOME TAX REPORT" TO RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM HDR-1
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           ...
           MOVE WS-TOTAL-TAX TO TRL-TAX
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM TRL-LINE
           CLOSE EMP-FILE RPT-FILE

downstream_effects.statement: Payroll / finance systems: The total tax withheld figure (WS-TOTAL-TAX) printed on the trailer line represents the organization's aggregate statutory tax remittance obligation. Any downstream payroll ledger, general-ledger interface, or tax-authority submission process that relies on this report will consume this figure.

code_references.snippet: 01  WS-TOTAL-TAX            PIC 9(09)V99 VALUE 0.

MOVE WS-TOTAL-TAX TO TRL-TAX
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM TRL-LINE

downstream_effects.statement: Console / job log: The DISPLAY statement emits 'TAXCALC: TAX REPORT WRITTEN' to standard output or the JES job log, which may be monitored by job scheduling systems (e.g., CA7, TWS) to confirm successful completion before triggering dependent jobs.

code_references.snippet: DISPLAY "TAXCALC: TAX REPORT WRITTEN"
